# Versioned prompts for a future experiment protocol

Status: proposed, not loaded by active A1/A2/B1/B2 workers. Input-contract
guidance changes the experimental treatment. Freeze its version and hash,
apply the same harness guidance across cells, and rerun a matched study before
comparing its scores with that protocol. Keep source-informed review outside
the audience model's documentation-only exposure.

## API test generation supplement

Identify the canonical target and the inputs required by its documented call.
Choose supplied fixtures, constructed values, or literals and explain their
types, dimensions, units, and formats. Use only documented behavior to justify
the assertion. Do not invent repository paths. Write temporary outputs only
under the supplied condition-owned output directory. Include a direct target
call and a deterministic assertion with a compact witness. If inputs or
dependencies are unsuitable, return a structured blocker with evidence rather
than fabricate a passing test. A blocker remains in the denominator and is
classified under the frozen scoring policy.

## Independent review prompt

Given the exact script, recorded output, source revision, documentation
treatment, input metadata, and dependency evidence, check: target owner;
actual arguments; shape/dtype/units/file schema; receiver construction;
output paths; assertion rationale; and whether wrong output would fail it.
Separate runtime observations from static inference. Assign verified,
mismatch, needs review, or not applicable with evidence and confidence.
Retain the native outcome and propose diagnostics separately. Do not infer
documentation causality from an execution error alone. Do not modify the
measured snippet or supply this source-informed review to the audience.

## Operator prompt

Continue from supervisors, locks, checkpoints, and recorded report state.
Verify exclusive output ownership and compatible source/configuration/data
before resuming work. Preserve live jobs and completed artifacts. Use observed
throughput to report scoped timing scenarios; state unmeasured stages. Separate
provider attempts, comprehension attempts, document repair rounds, and
diagnostic changes. Update the evidence-backed report and the architecture
note when actual behavior changes. Preserve the user's deadline priorities.
